_why: Every functional and timing run uses this one browser, launched by path: installed Chrome updates itself mid-run, and Playwright's bundled Chromium crashes reading a stored folder handle (verify-in-browser). This build survived that read on reload 3 of 3. `node verify/install-browser.mjs` downloads this machine's entry and checks its bytes and sha256; every hash below was computed from the downloaded archive.

mac-arm64.executable: chrome-mac-arm64/Google Chrome for Testing.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome for Testing

mac-x64.executable: chrome-mac-x64/Google Chrome for Testing.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome for Testing
